player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Player {player_id} ({piece}) rai sai. Hpang de ahte Opponent ({opp}) rai sai.
Nanhte galaw ya '[a2 a3]' (kaw na → kaw hting) hku shang.
- Galaw kaba wa gaw kaw shing rai kaw hting hpang de du hkra kaw shing rai.
- Dap hku gaw kaw shing rai hkum tsap dap re hting hpang de sa wa kaw shing rai.
Dap hku re {score_per_capture} shayi shang hkra.
Mali gaw {max_moves} galaw kaba wa hku shang rai sai, rai kaw na galaw kaba wa n re hku shang rai sai.
